blocks.body:
name = "acme/moved-keys"
version = "1.0.0"
[training]
deterministic = true
verifier_latency_p50 = "0.4s"

[trajectory]
tokens = "optional"
format = "atif"
span_attributes = []

[world]
kind = "virtual"

[world.desktop]
timezone = "America/Los_Angeles"
clock = "frozen:2026-03-14T09:00:00"

diagnostics.message: [training] deterministic is gone: whether a reward is deterministic is computed (no model-judged criterion and no monitor behavior), and judge noise is measured as retest and reward_noise in the rubric's validation (docs/rubrics.md). Remove the key

[training] verifier_latency_p50 is gone: grading latency is measured, not declared. Episode results report grading time, and task check --level rl requires the measurement as evidence (docs/training.md). Remove the key
[trajectory] tokens is gone: token records are asked for per run, by episode@1's record_tokens and token_owner (docs/runtime/episodes.md), not declared by the task. Remove the key

[trajectory] format is gone: every runtime records trajectory-1 (docs/runtime/episodes.md), and ATIF and OpenTelemetry are formats a trajectory is exported to, not something a task declares. Remove the key; [trajectory] require stays

[trajectory] span_attributes is gone: it named OpenTelemetry span attributes, and trajectory-1, the record every runtime keeps, has no spans. Remove the key; to require subagents' steps, write [trajectory] require = ["subagents"]

[world.desktop] clock moved to [sandbox] clock: write [sandbox] clock = { start = "2026-03-14T09:00:00-07:00", advance = "none", enforce = "world" }, which is what "frozen:2026-03-14T09:00:00" meant, and set network = "none" for the agent's phase, which a clock requires
